verdict.rationale: Pika documents its own lip-sync feature: you upload an image plus speech or a voice recording and get an animated performance with AI lip sync (pika-docs-52). A Talking Head app takes a script or your own image and audio (pika-docs-14, pika-docs-59), and text-to-speech can produce the dialogue audio (pika-docs-63), so the core story is covered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of lip-sync accuracy, in-depth documentation of the lip-sync controls, and evidence that this works for reusable custom characters or multi-character dialogue scenes rather than single-image performances.
